game_integrated_functions.name: 人物/宠物HP与气阈值自动补给
game_integrated_functions.rules: Authorized game action only; costs consumables; no fake healing or original historical threshold claim.

game_integrated_functions.name: 可编辑的回合战术预设/自动防御/自动逃跑
game_integrated_functions.rules: Same action budget, valid skills and standard turn timing; optional interruption.

game_integrated_functions.name: 宠物图鉴与成长记录/预测面板
game_integrated_functions.rules: Measured history vs model projection clearly separated; unknown base stats remain unknown; no fabricated IVs.

game_integrated_functions.name: 寻路、已探索地图标注、生活任务指引
game_integrated_functions.rules: Use discovered tiles and legal pathfinding; do not teleport through doors or unrevealed worlds.

game_integrated_functions.name: 一键整理背包/批量料理/重复生活操作
game_integrated_functions.rules: Consumes real ingredients, costs and crafting time; bounded batch and cancellation.

game_integrated_functions.name: 自动捕宠目标筛选/成长评估
game_integrated_functions.rules: No guaranteed capture, no auto-generating rare encounters, never silently discards valuable creatures.

game_integrated_functions.name: 经验、掉落、捕宠历史、训练日志
game_integrated_functions.rules: Observable local game state only, player privacy; no false source/version claim.

game_integrated_functions.name: 任务攻略百科与版本/来源追踪
game_integrated_functions.rules: Authentic historic vs new-story quests distinctly marked; spoiler control; respect content licensing.

game_integrated_functions.name: 挂机和脚本批处理
game_integrated_functions.rules: Opt-in offline-only deterministic action API, bounded energy/time, pause-on-risk; no plugin external code execution.

game_integrated_functions.name: 倍速、跳过重复演出、战斗动画加速
game_integrated_functions.rules: Local presentation pacing adjustable; don't rely on packet-timing exploits.

game_integrated_functions.name: 断线重登、多开、脱机对服务器发包
game_integrated_functions.rules: Offline game uses autosave/recovery and one player state; no credentials, external bots or multibox demand.

game_integrated_functions.name: 复制宠物/道具、越权传送、封包篡改、收费欺诈
game_integrated_functions.rules: Historically catalog only; never import as default core rules or bypass task progression.
